open_items: OECD gateway_issue: 403 Forbidden on gateway list_dataflows and gateway data probe (https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/dataflow/all/all/latest), direct path healthy throughout. First occurrence of this pattern for OECD (not in the prior chronic-flap list). Began cycle 290, still open at cycle 292 (3 consecutive cycles, ~6h) -- unlike every other known gateway/direct flap in this repo, which cleared within one cycle. Live recheck at 2026-08-18T12:45Z hit the exact failing URL directly and got HTTP 200 with no Cloudflare challenge, so the direct request itself is fine; the gateway's own outbound request (different IP, MCP-driven) is the one being rejected. Could not test the gateway host itself (sdmx-mcp-gateway-production.up.railway.app is outside this session's network allowlist). Watch for resolution at cycle 293; if still open, treat as a real incident worth investigating gateway egress IP / headers against OECD's Cloudflare rules.
